evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-09-02, told Dave he booked a flight to Boston "last week" (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is "so excited" about the upcoming Boston trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it — "See you soon, buddy!"; he'll let Dave know when he's in Boston, and Dave told him to let him know when he's free so they can catch up in Boston (continuing the plan to meet up in Boston, see above) [S17T6][S17T7][S17T8]. The chat closed with Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you! Have a safe trip, see ya!"; Calvin thanked Dave, reciprocated the safe-trip wishes ("Gotta stay safe on the trip"), said "Can't wait to see you there!", and promised he will contact Dave when he arrives [S17T9][S17T10].
- On 2023-09-13, re-pledged the plan to let Dave know when he's in Boston — "I'll let you know when I'm in Boston" — and accepted Dave's offer to check out his garage and its cool cars (Dave shared a photo of the garage — a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign — "looks stunning!"), saying it would be fun and might give him ideas for future projects (details in ## Relationships; Dave's side in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S18T11][S18T12].
- On 2023-10-04, was in Boston: he told Dave he had met with artists there the day before (2023-10-03) to plan a music collaboration (continuation of the planned Boston visit from his late-2023-08/early-2023-09 flight booking above; details in ## Music) [S21T1].
- On 2023-10-25, told Dave that the day before (2023-10-24) he had a great time sightseeing in Boston with a high school friend — "really fun and eye-opening"; he found Boston "a wonderful experience" with "awesome architecture and a really cool history," and said it was "so peaceful" — following Dave's advice (continuation of his late-2023-08/early-2023-09 Boston visit, see above; details in ## Relationships) [S26T1][S26T3].
- On 2023-10-29, while looking at Dave's Boston photos (the sunset-over-the-skyline photo and a close-up of the clock tower, see the 2023-10-29 entry in ## Music and the Photography section of /memories/dave.md), Calvin recognized the clock tower and said he was in Boston a few years back — "it's such a beautiful city." (a second, separate Boston visit, in addition to his late-2023-08/early-2023-09 visit above; "a few years back" — exact date not given) [S27T5][S27T7].

- On 2023-09-22, caught up with Dave ("Hey Calvin, good to catch up again!"): Dave told him he'd been working on the engine of the vintage Mustang — thought he'd fixed it, but when he started it up he heard a weird noise — "So disappointing after putting so much work in" — and asked Calvin to look at the engine (photo of a car engine with a small engine; details in the Car mod workshop (2023-08-11) section of /memories/dave.md); Calvin sympathized — "sorry to hear about the car trouble. That must be disappointing after putting so much work into it. Yeah, fixing cars can be tricky." — then shared a photo of his red sports car (Ferrari) parked in a parking lot: "It's a sign of my hard work and dedication. Looking at it reminds me how far I've come." (details in ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26)); Dave: "I love the way the sunlight hits this. It's definitely a great symbol of all your hard work. I bet you feel really proud when you look at it." and asked if there were any special memories with it; Calvin: an amazing drive "one summer day" — "The wind blowing through my hair and the rush of freedom - it was unforgettable" — and he's "pondered the intricacies of life, taking a moment to truly appreciate the path I've chosen and the decisions that have shaped my journey"; also said his trip to Japan was incredible — "the culture, the people, everything was so cool" — "I'm already longing to go back, it was an experience that made all the hard work worth it." (details in ## Japan plan); Dave: "Wow, Calvin, that's awesome! That feeling of freedom in the summer is the best. A moment of reflection not only makes the journey interesting but also productive!" and asked whether any song from Calvin's childhood brings back memories; Calvin: "there's this one song that always makes me smile. It played during a road trip with my dad and we had so much fun singing along to it."; Dave: "Sounds awesome, Calvin! Road trips with family are always a treat. What's the name of the song?"; Calvin: "We used to rock a song by Tupac and Dr. Dre called 'California Love.' Ah, those were the days!" (details in ## Music); Dave: "Sounds great, Cal! 'California Love' is a classic! Let me know if you wanna jam some music together!"; Calvin: "Yeah, let's do it! That would be awesome." — the two are now planning to jam some music together; Dave: "I'm stoked, Calvin! We can crank up the music and have an awesome jam session. Can't wait!"; Calvin: "Yeah, Dave! Gonna be great! Can't wait to see what we can do."; Dave: "Yeah, let's do it! It'll be awesome. Let's rock it!"; Calvin: "Yeah, let's do this! I can't wait!"; the conversation closed with Dave: "Nice one, Calvin! Let's make some awesome memories and have a great time. See ya soon!", and Calvin: "Count me in. Can't wait to create something special. See you soon!", and Dave's final parting: "Yep, Calvin! Can't wait to see you soon. Take it easy till then." - On 2023-10-04, caught up with Dave ("Hey Dave!"): told him he met with "incredible" artists in Boston the day before (2023-10-03) and talked about working together — arranged through a mutual friend who "knew we'd be a great fit" — and is "stoked to collaborate with them on new music" ("an inspiring and exciting experience"; Dave: "Awesome! ... Can't wait to hear what you come up with in your collaboration. Let me know how it goes!"; Calvin: "Can't wait to show you the final result." — details in ## Music); the chat then switched to relaxing hobbies: Calvin said he loves working on a car project "to chill out" and shared a photo of a shiny orange car with its hood open (details in ## Music); Dave: "Wow, Calvin, that car looks great! Working on cars really helps me relax, it's therapeutic to see them come back to life" and told him he's been restoring the Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard — "in bad shape, but I knew it had potential" (details in /memories/dave.md, Car mod workshop (2023-08-11) section); Calvin asked for photos of it "looking amazing" ("I'd love to see how it turned out!"); Dave shared a photo of a red car parked in a field with other cars — "I put in a lot of work restoring it, but the result is awesome. It's so satisfying to bring an old car back to life."; Calvin: "We've been greatly privileged to have been granted this opportunity. It's so satisfying to bring it back to life!" and shared a photo of dirty hands next to a car, and Dave shared a photo of his own dirt-stained hands after a day in the garage — "permanently stained with grease. But it's worth it when you see the end result." Calvin: "Yeah, Dave! Those hands show you worked hard. You put in lots of effort. You should definitely be proud!", and the two closed the chat with mutual encouragement — both agreed it's motivating and inspiring to see the progress and development in their projects and in themselves, that those little wins give a sense of accomplishment and bring joy, and that hard work, dedication, and determination are key to reaching their goals and potential and what sets them apart, and that they'll never give up and keep pushing for more — Calvin: "those little wins matter... It's truly inspiring to see how much we can grow," "Agreed, Dave!... Let's never give up and keep striving for success... Onwards to our goals!" and Dave: "It's the small successes that make me feel proud and fulfilled," "Hard work really does pay off!", "It's really motivating and keeps me pushing for more.", "Let's keep going! We won't lose focus on our goals. Hard work and determination will get us there. Let's do this!"; the chat then closed with final goodbyes — Calvin: "Yeah, let's do it! Let's stay focused and work hard to make our dreams happen. We can make it happen together! Wishing you all the best until we meet again!" and Dave: "Yep, Calvin! Together, we can do amazing things if we work together and stay motivated. We got this! Take care and stay well!" (Calvin's car-project details in ## Music; Dave's side of the whole exchange, including his small-successes sentiment, in the 2023-10-04 entry of the Relationships section and the Hobbies and sense of purpose section of /memories/dave.md) [S21T1][S21T2][S21T3][S21T4][S21T5][S21T6][S21T7][S21T8][S21T9][S21T10][S21T11][S21T12][S21T13][S21T14][S21T15][S21T16][S21T17][S21T18].
- On 2023-10-08, caught up with Dave ("Hey Dave! What's up?"): Dave told him that last Friday (2023-10-06) he went to a car show — saw awesome cars, got to mess with car mods, and there were so many cool machines around — "it was so much fun!" — and shared a photo of "this beautiful car" (a photography of two men looking at a car engine); Calvin: "Hey Dave, that sounds awesome! I'm into the rush of awesome cars. Can't wait to check out your garage." and shared a photo of a red sports car parked in a showroom (see ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26)) [S22T1][S22T2]. Dave: "Thanks! Yeah, this one looks great!" and said he restored and modified the car himself, adding a custom exhaust and some performance upgrades — it's "got a sweet sound" and he's "really proud of how it turned out"; Calvin: "Wow, Dave! You really turned it into a masterpiece. Impressive!" (shared a photo of a car driving down a street with a traffic light) [S22T3][S22T4]. Dave then said car restoration "is not just a hobby, it's a passion" — "like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress" — that as a kid he'd spend hours in his dad's garage tinkering with engines ("it was like my own sanctuary"), and he's now "lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome"; Calvin: "Wow, Dave, that's amazing. Bringing broken things back to life is so satisfying. Working on cars can be a real escape from reality, and I understand that feeling. Doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal, right? Keep going with it, it's really inspiring." Dave: "Thanks, Calvin. It's been my goal since I was a kid and it's awesome to be able to do something I love. Restoring things like this can be tough but the feeling of accomplishment it gives is great. Absolutely, I'm loving it." (Dave's details in the Classic cars and Hobbies and sense of purpose sections of /memories/dave.md) [S22T5][S22T6][S22T7]. Calvin: "Go for it, Dave! Chasing your dreams is what life's about. It's awesome to see how far you've come. Keep working hard and living your best life." [S22T8].
- The 2023-10-08 conversation continued: Dave thanked Calvin — "Thanks, Calvin! Means a lot." — and said he's going to keep chasing his dreams and working hard, that conversations like this remind him why he loves what he does (Dave's side in the 2023-10-08 entry of the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S22T9]; Calvin: "Glad I can remind you, Dave. Keep up the good work and stay focused. You got this!" [S22T10]; Dave: "Thanks, Calvin! Your support really means a lot. I'll stay focused and keep going. Appreciate the encouragement!" [S22T11]; Calvin: "Yeah Dave! I'll always be here to support you and give you that boost. You're doing great!" [S22T12]; Dave: "Thanks so much, Calvin. Your support means everything to me. I'll keep pushing and reaching for them." [S22T13]; the conversation closed with Calvin: "No worries, Dave. Keep going for it. You got this!" [S22T14].
- On 2023-10-15, reconnected with Dave ("Hey Cal, miss ya!"): Dave told him it's been "a crazy rollercoaster week" — a competing car maintenance shop snagged a deal Dave's shop had been trying to secure for months — and that he felt "kinda bummed out," questioning whether his hard work was a waste ("Am I wasting my time?"); Calvin: "Hey Dave, sorry to hear that. It can be discouraging when you feel like your hard work goes unnoticed. But don't give up, keep pushing and believe in yourself. The payoff will be worth it."; Dave: "Calvin, thanks for the encouragement. It can be tough when you feel like your efforts are going unseen. I gotta have faith and patience. I'm sure it's only a matter of time till things work out." and asked how Calvin stays motivated when faced with setbacks; Calvin: "When setbacks come my way, I remind myself why I'm passionate about my goals. I rely on helpful people around me and take a break to recharge with my favorite activities. That always helps me get back to feeling motivated." (details in ## Music); Dave: "That's a great approach, Cal! Reminding yourself of the passion for the goals and getting help from others is really important. Taking a break and having fun sounds so refreshing." and then told Calvin he just got back from a music festival — "it was amazing! The energy, the music, the crowd - sooo good. I felt so alive!" (Dave's details in the Music section of /memories/dave.md); Calvin: "Wow Dave, sounds awesome! Music festivals bring so much joy and the energy of the crowd can be amazing." and asked for photos from the festival — "I'd love to check them out and join in on the fun."; Dave shared a photo of the main stage (a photo of a stage with a crowd of people watching a band) — "The main stage was unreal. The headliner was so good and the vibe was unreal!"; Calvin: "Wow, that looks awesome! The crowd looks really excited and the stage is incredible. Who was the headliner?" — Dave had not answered that question as the chat ended; the conversation then continued (below) and Dave identified The Fireworks as the headliner [S23T1][S23T2][S23T3][S23T4][S23T5][S23T6][S23T7][S23T8].
